title: The Signature Emergency Assistance Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Official emergency grants, food assistance, housing support, and eligibility. The Emergency Assistance Database records emergency resources for students in crisis: emergency grant programs, food assistance, emergency housing, and how to access each one quickly, from official institutional and nonprofit sources. Records prioritize access speed: what to do in the next 24 hours comes first. The Signature side adds action plans ordered by urgency.
capabilities: Record emergency grants, food, and housing resources
Prioritize resources by access speed and urgency
Document eligibility and application steps per resource
Link to official institutional and nonprofit sources
Provide urgency-ordered action plans

body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout.
